about: Every pack in turn on one build: apply, Settings (home, Display, Sound and vibration), My Files > Internal storage, Quick panel, light and dark, with each pack's own crash buffer. Carnelian and the other go-to-top packs first, then the default pack and the 5 new packs; ends on Willemite. Pass/fail is per pack in sweep.tsv (picked, applied, crashes) and screens.tsv (top activity at each shot); the sweep step fails if any pack did not apply or crashed.
